shortDescription: Venezuela and TotalEnergies SE signed a memorandum of understanding on Saturday, paving the way for the French company to resume operations in the South American country, according to Bloomberg.

title: Venezuela, TotalEnergies Sign Pact for French Oil Major’s Return
